paper_metadata.title: Effect of temperature and cooling regime on mechanical properties of high-strength low-alloy steel

evidence.quote: This paper presents results from experimental studies on the effect of temperature on mechanical properties of high-strength low-alloy ASTM A572 steel commonly used in structural members in bridges.

rectangular steel coupons were cut from A572 Gr. 50 steel sheets.
For evaluating residual strength of A572 Gr. 50 steel after heating and cooling to room temperature through air cooling or water quenching
A rate of heating of 10 °C/min was adopted to heat the coupon to a target temperature [12].
When the target temperature is attained, the specimen was kept at this temperature for 30 min so as to attain a steady-state condition throughout the specimen.
the steel coupon was placed in the furnace and heated to a target temperature at a heating rate of 10 °C/min.
Then, the specimen was maintained at the target temperature for 2 h.
the coupons were left in the furnace after heating, to naturally cool down to room temperature
the coupons were quenched in water to cool down to room temperature.
